qualification.package: Clean source wheel/sdist, focused CPU checks, image imports and default pipeline CLI entrypoint verified. Both images use the same public source Dockerfile and pinned Sol setup. No model weights are bundled.
qualification.engine: The 0.7.0 core executed complete five-second 512-square keyframe generation and four-step low-noise repaint on one RTX 4090 with explicit 44 sparse / 6 dense attention layers. This used application-owned prepared assets and a separately provisioned Veda environment.
qualification.limits: The new standalone public images have CPU/dependency/CLI verification, not a new GPU qualification matrix. Prior profile evidence remains workload-specific. Veda, FROST and face-restoration assets require explicit provisioning. No general quality or latency claim and no claim that consuming services have upgraded.
